_comment: THE PLATFORM'S GLOBAL in-app/email/sms templates our OWN services send through — one row per (key, locale), upserted by seed-notification-templates.sh on every install. Placeholders use stdlib string.Template ($name, not {name} — see notification-service's own adapters/renderer/safe.py). category is always 'transactional' here: none of these are marketing, so none need a NOTIFY_CONSENT_PURPOSES mapping. ar/en are the product's own, written with the same care as the rest of the console; ur/ha/fil are MACHINE-ASSISTED, NOT NATIVE-REVIEWED — same posture apps/console/src/screens/team-i18n.ts already states for the same three languages, and for the same reason (guest-labour staff who read no other locale here at all).

ar.subject: انخفاض في تقييم أحد الموظفين
ar.body: تراجع متوسط تقييم $name إلى $average من 5 خلال آخر تقييماته. يُنصح بمراجعة أدائه في أقرب وقت.

en.subject: Staff rating drop
en.body: $name's average rating has fallen to $average out of 5 over their recent ratings. Reviewing their performance is recommended.

ur.subject: عملے کی درجہ بندی میں کمی
ur.body: $name کی اوسط درجہ بندی حالیہ جائزوں میں گھٹ کر 5 میں سے $average ہو گئی ہے۔ ان کی کارکردگی کا جائزہ لینے کی سفارش کی جاتی ہے۔

ha.subject: Faɗuwar kimar ma'aikaci
ha.body: Matsakaicin kimar $name ya faɗi zuwa $average daga 5 a cikin kimace-kimacen kwanan nan. Ana ba da shawarar duba aikinsa.

fil.subject: Pagbaba ng rating ng empleyado
fil.body: Bumaba ang average rating ni $name sa $average sa 5 batay sa mga huling rating. Inirerekomenda ang pagsusuri sa kanyang performance.

ar.subject: طلب شراكة استراتيجية جديد
ar.body: محل آخر مسجّل عندنا يقترح شراكة إحالة عملاء معك. راجع الشروط ووافق أو ارفض من شاشة الشراكات.

en.subject: New referral partnership proposal
en.body: Another shop on our platform is proposing a customer-referral partnership with you. Review the terms and approve or reject it from the partnerships screen.

ar.subject: طلب إنهاء شراكة استراتيجية
ar.body: الطرف الثاني بشراكة الإحالة معك طلب إنهاءها قبل موعدها. الشراكة تبقى فعّالة حتى توافق أنت.

en.subject: Referral partnership cancellation requested
en.body: Your referral partnership partner has requested early cancellation. The partnership stays active until you approve it.
